title: Jensen Huang broke Nvidia’s code of conduct, and his employees may not forget it
summary: Most codes of conduct serve as a reflection of corporate culture. In Nvidia's case, that could have consequences.
reason: Commentary about Nvidia's corporate culture/code of conduct. No named model or capability release (group 1), no research artifact (group 2), no financing/M&A/partnership/revenue data or product launch (group 3), no policy action (group 4), no open-source tooling (group 5). No rule covers it.
